title: Market sell-off an opportunity to buy dip, says Aureus' Kari Firestone
description: Kari Firestone of Aureus Asset Management and Jill Carey Hall of Bank of America Merrill Lynch discuss the markets on CNBC's "Closing Bell."

asr.full_text: close to a 5% pullback and then recovered some of that. When we had looked at different scenarios that we at Bank of America had put together around this, one of our expectations was that if the tariffs went up from 10% to 25% on these Chinese goods, we could see a 5% pullback in the market and then an extended period of volatility, since if it looks like we're not going to get a resolution right away, talks are continuing, we're going to have some time in between. This is going to be a volatile period for the market and any news on trade can contribute to that volatility. So obviously some optimism today, but we do expect volatility to be here to stay until we can get to a resolution. Carrie, how have you been navigating through all of these twists and turns on trade? Well, I think we expected that at a certain THAT AT A CERTAIN POINT THE MARKET WAS GOING TO HAVE TO CORRECT SOMEWHAT. WE HAD TO MOVE UP 25% FROM DECEMBER 26TH, YOU KNOW, STRAIGHT UPWARD. AT THIS RATE THE MARKET WOULD BE UP 55% FOR THE YEAR, SO 5% IS COMFORTABLE. IF IT WAS 10%, I THINK WE'D WORRY, BUT IF IT WAS 7%, WE WOULD BE BUYING. THE MARKET WOULD BE TRADING AT 15 OR SO TIMES EARNINGS. YOU ARE NOT FINDING THE DIP JUST YET. WE STARTED BUYING TODAY, YEAH. IN FACT, THERE ARE A FEW NAMES THAT WE ADDED TO POSITIONS, WE OWNED 34 NAMES, WE BOUGHT SILICON VALLEY BANK, WE BOUGHT A LITTLE EVILIS, WE BOUGHT A FEW. HOME DEPOT WE ARE GOING TO BE BUYING. THEY HAVE BEEN HIT AND WE THINK THAT THE MARKET RIGHT HERE CAN PAUSE FOR A BIT, BUT IT DOESN'T HAVE TO FALL A LOT that a lot of people were saying, they have to go ahead as quickly as possible because the number of markets we're going to be buying, the number of jobs that we're going to be buying, the number of homes for the home depot, we're gonna be buying, they have been hit and we think that the market right here can pause for a bit, but it doesn't have to fall out more. I think that the level of volume, which people have talked about a lot being weak, remember the market has a short memory. It's not so short that it doesn't remember December DECEMBER. NOBODY KNEW WHAT GOES ON IN LONG TERMS. IT'S AS EXPECTED. NOBODY WANTED TO GO PLOW IN FULL-SPEED AHEAD AND HAVE TOMORROW BE A DISASTROUS DAY. I THINK IT'S GREAT THAT THE MARKET IS UP ABOUT A PERCENT AND WE CAN WORRY ABOUT THE LATER.

Although the speakers discuss buying market positions and named stocks, they also emphasize volatility and do not present guaranteed returns, require payment or credentials, or solicit audience participation. The closing CNBC subscribe message is ordinary channel engagement and is not linked to an investment offer.
